We want the default to be larger than the default gc.tll, which is 4 hours. Daily has the added bonus that the scheduling framework has logic to avoid running all @daily jobs at the same time.

fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/110132

Release note (sql change): The default value for ttl_job_cron (the table storage parameter that controls the default recurrence of the row-level TTL job), is now @daily. It previously was @hourly.

issue_context.title: Change default row level TTL cron job to run every 4 hours instead of every hour
issue_context.body:
Currently the row level TTL job runs every hour. This is suboptimal as gc.ttl is 4 hour by default. Running it more frequently within that window means having to scan over a larger number of delete tombstones. We should default to 4 hours to match gc.ttl in this case so we have less things to scan.

Jira issue: CRDB-31278

Epic CRDB-27601
comments: We might want to add something so that the "every 4 hour" schedule falls on a random minute in the hour. We have something similar for `@hourly` schedules.
Confirmed with @dikshant offline that we can use `@daily` here. The benefit is that `@daily` already has the logic to pick a random time of day, instead of running at `00:00` every day.
